segments.text: We can use this conversation to understand your current routine. Please tell me if you need to stop before we finish.
यह ठीक है और मैं अभी सवालों का जवाब दे सकता हूँ। बात हमारे यहाँ <COMPANY_1> के काम पर ही रखें।
Main kai jagah adhoore kaam ki tippani se pareshani dekhta hoon. Shayad aapke kaam mein bhi yahi sabse badi pareshani hogi.
To make that point clear, Missing notes are not the problem I am describing here. हमारी असली परेशानी यह है कि लौटाया हुआ सामान गलत टीम को भेज दिया जाता है।
How do people record the work before handing it over? Main badlaav sujhane se pehle aapki prakriya samajhna chahta hoon.
We use a shared paper list to record the work. The person taking over reads that list before starting anything.
आपके काम में उपयोगी सुधार कैसा दिखाई देगा? कृपया ऐसा बदलाव बताइए जो आपको काम करते समय दिखाई दे।
Kaam ek vyakti se doosre tak jaaye to intezaar kam ho. Mere liye poori prakriya badalne se zyada yahi zaroori hai.
I can describe a proposed checklist for the handoff process. यह रूपरेखा है और इसे लागू करने पर सहमति नहीं हुई है।
We cannot replace our current routine while work is active. Badlaav ka yeh jokhim abhi aapka prastaav khareedne se rokta hai.
Let us move on to the page layout in the outline. The headings are arranged so that they can be read quickly.
मैं अभी भी चाहता हूँ कि बदलाव का जोखिम गंभीरता से लें। रूपरेखा लिखते समय कृपया इस चिंता को साफ तौर पर रखें।
Mujhe paisa manzoor maanne ke bajaay uski pushti poochhni chahiye. Aapke sangathan ka varnan us manzoori ko saabit nahin karta.
I do not know whether funding has been approved yet. इस बात की पुष्टि से पहले मुझे <PERSON_2> से पूछना होगा।
What would you want included in a short written outline? Main khareedne ko kahe bina prastavit kaam saumpne ki vidhi samjha sakta hoon.
Send me a short outline, and I will think about it. I am not agreeing to a meeting or a purchase here.
समय बदलने की संभावना के बारे में अभी क्या अनिश्चित है? हम सहमति मानने के बजाय अनिश्चितता दर्ज कर सकते हैं।

segments.text: We can use this conversation to understand your current routine. Please tell me if you need to stop before we finish.
That works for me, and I can answer questions now. Let us keep the discussion about our routine at <COMPANY_1>.
I sometimes see missing handoff notes create problems for teams. Perhaps that is the main problem in your routine too.
Missing notes are not the problem I am describing here. Our actual problem is that approval requests arrive without the supporting document.
How do people record the work before handing it over? I want to understand the process before suggesting a change.
We use a shared paper list to record the work. The person taking over reads that list before starting anything.
What would a useful improvement look like in your work? Please describe the change you would actually notice in practice.
I would like less waiting when work moves between people. That matters more to me than changing the whole routine.
I can describe a proposed checklist for the handoff process. This is an outline, and we have not agreed to implement it.
We cannot replace our current routine while work is active. That changeover risk would stop us from buying your proposal now.
Which part of a changeover would create the most risk? Could you describe where active work would be interrupted first?
I still need the changeover risk to be taken seriously. Please keep that concern visible when you write the outline.
I should check rather than assume that funding is approved. A description of your organisation cannot establish that approval.
I do not know whether funding has been approved yet. I would need to ask <PERSON_2> before confirming that point.
What would you want included in a short written outline? I can describe the proposed handoff without asking for a purchase.
Send me a short outline, and I will think about it. I am not agreeing to a meeting or a purchase here.
What remains uncertain about a possible change in timing? We can write down the uncertainty instead of assuming agreement.
I am not sure whether the proposed timing will work. I need a reply from the team before I can confirm it.

segments.text: We can use this conversation to understand your current routine. Please tell me if you need to stop before we finish.
यह ठीक है और मैं अभी सवालों का जवाब दे सकता हूँ। बात हमारे यहाँ <COMPANY_1> के काम पर ही रखें।
Main kai jagah adhoore kaam ki tippani se pareshani dekhta hoon. Shayad aapke kaam mein bhi yahi sabse badi pareshani hogi.
Missing notes are not the problem I am describing here. हमारी असली परेशानी यह है कि मंजूरी के अनुरोध जरूरी दस्तावेज के बिना पहुँचते हैं।
How do people record the work before handing it over? Main badlaav sujhane se pehle aapki prakriya samajhna chahta hoon.
We use a shared paper list to record the work. The person taking over reads that list before starting anything.
आपके काम में उपयोगी सुधार कैसा दिखाई देगा? कृपया ऐसा बदलाव बताइए जो आपको काम करते समय दिखाई दे।
Kaam ek vyakti se doosre tak jaaye to intezaar kam ho. Mere liye poori prakriya badalne se zyada yahi zaroori hai.
I can describe a proposed checklist for the handoff process. यह रूपरेखा है और इसे लागू करने पर सहमति नहीं हुई है।
We cannot replace our current routine while work is active. Badlaav ka yeh jokhim abhi aapka prastaav khareedne se rokta hai.
Which part of a changeover would create the most risk? Could you describe where active work would be interrupted first?
मैं अभी भी चाहता हूँ कि बदलाव का जोखिम गंभीरता से लें। रूपरेखा लिखते समय कृपया इस चिंता को साफ तौर पर रखें।
Mujhe paisa manzoor maanne ke bajaay uski pushti poochhni chahiye. Aapke sangathan ka varnan us manzoori ko saabit nahin karta.
I do not know whether funding has been approved yet. इस बात की पुष्टि से पहले मुझे <PERSON_2> से पूछना होगा।
What would you want included in a short written outline? Main khareedne ko kahe bina prastavit kaam saumpne ki vidhi samjha sakta hoon.
Send me a short outline, and I will think about it. I am not agreeing to a meeting or a purchase here.
समय बदलने की संभावना के बारे में अभी क्या अनिश्चित है? हम सहमति मानने के बजाय अनिश्चितता दर्ज कर सकते हैं।
Mujhe pakka nahin pata ki prastavit samay theek rahega ya nahin. Pushti dene se pehle mujhe toli ka jawaab chahiye.
